runtimeContract.controllerBoundary: Stable destinations, selection synchronization and page switching remain generated-page responsibilities; internal item sets remain SDK anatomy.

runtimeContract.accessibility: non-interactive workflow progress; current step is exposed through the accessible description
each visible page and previous/next action is a named keyboard-focusable child
the root is not focusable; each anchor is a named keyboard-focusable action and the current section is exposed through accessible descriptions
runtimeContract.ownership: the component emits controlled activation requests; the page owns scrolling and feeds the observed section back through currentIndex

runtimeContract.controllerBoundary: Search execution, notification data and profile-menu routing remain generated-page responsibilities.
Route resolution, permissions, active-route synchronization and page switching remain generated-page responsibilities.
QAction remains command identity and data authority; hover, active and keyboard highlight are transient native states, while MenuItem remains internal anatomy.
QAction and ComponentLab/Menu remain shared runtime authorities; open, hover, keyboard and disabled are native action states, while the corner widget content remains consumer-owned.
QAction remains shared command authority; QMainWindow owns real docking and floating lifecycle, while the Figma Placement axis is a deterministic appearance specimen.
QTabWidget owns page visibility, keyboard selection, close-request signaling and page attachment; generated pages own close confirmation, deletion and persistence. TabItem remains internal anatomy.
QToolBox owns single-current-page selection and attached item pages. All-collapsed and multi-open behavior belongs to Collapse, not ToolBox; ToolBoxItem remains internal anatomy.

Area and Placement are design previews only. QMainWindow owns actual docking and tabification; floating, allowedAreas and DockWidgetFeatures remain native runtime authority and are never inferred from Figma variant values.

Free, Cascade and Tile are deterministic authored geometry previews, not Qt viewMode values or arrangement commands. Tabbed maps to QMdiArea::TabbedView; subsequent arrangement, activation, lifecycle, close veto, persistence and ownership remain runtime-owned.

State is deterministic paint metadata. Activation, QWidget window states, enabled, WindowFlags, close veto, system menu, move/resize and ownership remain native runtime authority and are never inferred as one mutually exclusive property.

Empty, Content and Disabled map to native page count/currentWidget/enabled semantics. The stack has no selector, route history or transition policy; removeWidget retains ownership and generated-page controllers own routing.

Style maps to the writable wizardStyle property. Phase is workflow preview metadata and never writes read-only currentId or visitedIds; branching, validation, button roles and accept/reject lifecycle remain QWizard authority.
Kind maps to setCommitPage/setFinalPage. Completion is paint metadata only and never replaces isComplete, mandatory fields, validatePage, nextId or initialize/cleanup lifecycle hooks.

runtimeContract.accessibility: non-interactive status text is exposed through accessibleName
non-interactive continuous state is exposed through accessibleName
read-only tag root is not focusable; the optional dismiss child has a distinct accessible name and keyboard focus
runtimeContract.ownership: the SDK emits dismissed intent; removal, persistence and undo remain generated-page controller responsibilities

runtimeContract.accessibility: non-interactive event history; event count and latest event are exposed through the accessible description

runtimeContract.controllerBoundary: MetricCard owns the card surface, state fallback copy and comparison or meta text. It does not parse or localize numeric values; consumers that need numeric formatting use ComponentLab/Statistic. Loading never exposes stale value content, while Empty and Error are explicit semantic states rather than numeric zero.

Determinate and Indeterminate map to native range mode, Disabled maps to QWidget enabled state, and Paused/Error/In-progress/Completed are horizontal visual semantics only. Runtime owns numeric value, range and update cadence; Figma busy frames are static review slices and do not define motion timing.

Start and End are logical design values resolved against QWidget layoutDirection. QLabel retains native text, pixmap, links, buddy and selection behavior; Label remains presentation-only and Qt::NoFocus.

The SDK owns Figma header geometry, single-letter weekday labels, grid presentation and semantic date-cell painting. Date range, locale, business-day rules, initial page and selected date remain runtime or generated-page data.

The SDK retains the raw numeric value separately from locale-formatted display text and affixes. Loading suppresses stale values; Empty and Error remain semantic fallbacks and never collapse to numeric zero. Update cadence and dynamic accessibility-announcement throttling remain host responsibilities.

The button retains Qt::StrongFocus and keyboard activation. Figma focus-visible is an input-modality preview; the shared FocusIndicator may suppress only the painted ring per component without changing focusPolicy or activation.

runtimeContract.accessibility: visible text supplies the accessible name; keyboard activation supports Space, Enter and Return
runtimeContract.ownership: snapshotState is a deterministic evidence and generated-static-state input; an empty value restores native interactive state resolution

runtimeContract.accessibility: keyboard-focusable secondary action with an accessible More actions name
the root is not focusable; both criteria and the apply action are named keyboard-focusable child actions with an optional FocusIndicator
runtimeContract.ownership: the SDK owns presentation and controlled activation requests; condition model, validation, clear, persistence and state transitions belong to the external filter controller

runtimeContract.controllerBoundary: The SDK maps the 34 valid Figma variants. QAction remains optional command authority; QMenu ownership, popup timing, activation and focus return remain native Qt runtime behavior. Menu=None preserves an existing non-split popup mode.

The root is a presentation/layout host. Native child buttons retain ButtonRole and platform QStyle ordering. DestructiveRole is not converted into accepted(), and Delete is never the Enter default. A root ring opt-out is inherited by all watched child buttons.
The SDK maps presentation and persistent checked state. Choice-group exclusivity, current selection and wizard or dialog navigation remain host-controller responsibilities.
Filled is derived from content occupancy and Error is an explicit visual state; validators, input masks, IME, selection, undo and context menus remain native.

runtimeContract.accessibility: the internal editor owns keyboard focus and exposes the search purpose
the active native spin editor owns keyboard focus and numeric semantics
StrongFocus acquisition surface with optional FocusIndicator, keyboard activation, accessible lifecycle text and local-file drop support
runtimeContract.ownership: SDK renders controlled acquisition and lifecycle state; page/upload service owns file dialog choice, constraints, validation, network transport, authentication, cancellation and retry

runtimeContract.keySemantics: keyPressed emits stable semantic keys; decimal display is localized separately, backspace is emitted as backspace, and commitRequested is emitted only when the external key layout contains commit
runtimeContract.accessibility: the root is not focusable; twelve named child actions use StrongFocus, two-dimensional arrow navigation and the optional FocusIndicator
runtimeContract.ownership: the SDK owns keypad presentation and input intentions; target field, value constraints, locale parsing, focus routing and commit policy belong to the external input controller

runtimeContract.controllerBoundary: The root composition remains Qt::NoFocus while its editor keeps native keyboard focus, IME and clipboard behavior. A root focusIndicatorEnabled override is inherited by the field chrome and child actions; it hides only the visual ring.
QTime, ordered range, parsing, locale, current section, wrapping and keyboard stepping remain native; wall-clock time does not imply a date, time zone or instant.
QAbstractSlider owns value, position, range, steps, tracking and inversion; the Figma value label never determines the native value and Dragging never persists sliderDown.
The host viewport and QStyle own range, pageStep, thumb proportion, hit testing and line-button behavior; Hover and Dragging do not persist sliderDown.

runtimeContract.colorSemantics: HexRgb displays #RRGGBB; HexArgb displays Qt #AARRGGBB; invalid QColor values are rejected
runtimeContract.accessibility: the field adapter has StrongFocus, exposes the current color as text and supports Space, Return and Enter activation with the optional FocusIndicator
runtimeContract.ownership: the SDK owns the visible swatch field and picker request; dialog choice, color space, alpha policy, recent colors, preview, commit and cancel belong to the external color-selection controller

runtimeContract.accessibility: each mutually-exclusive segment is keyboard focusable; arrows, Home and End move selection
NoFocus presentation root with named StrongFocus list views and direction actions; optional FocusIndicator inherits from the component root
runtimeContract.ownership: SDK composes the two list views and command affordances around caller-owned models; page selection controller owns queries, mutations, ordering, permissions and error recovery

runtimeContract.controllerBoundary: The checkbox retains Qt::StrongFocus, Space activation and accessibility behavior. Figma Focus-visible is a visual preview; ring suppression never changes check state, focusPolicy or keyboard input.

runtimeContract.accessibility: the header itself is presentation-only; the optional named action owns keyboard focus

runtimeContract.controllerBoundary: The splitter root is Qt::NoFocus and does not paint a universal focus ring. Pane widgets own keyboard focus. Legal ranges, collapsibility, persisted sizes and application-specific pane content remain generated-page responsibilities; Show grip changes only the visual grip and never the handle hit target.

The SDK owns the token-backed viewport and scrollbar identities. Content ownership, content size, scroll position and application data remain generated-page responsibilities. Qt::StrongFocus preserves keyboard scrolling; focusIndicatorEnabled may suppress only the painted ring.

runtimeContract.accessibility: tooltip never accepts focus; attachTo observes target hover, keyboard focus and Escape
runtimeContract.ownership: the generated page resolves the target and calls attachTo; the SDK owns hover, target-focus and Escape visibility behavior

runtimeContract.accessibility: the presentation root is not focusable; each host window action is a named keyboard-focusable child
